<style>
/* ================================================================
   SMELL DISCETTES – GLOBALE FUSSZEILE (Elementor Theme Builder)
   Eigener Wrapper .sdxf und eigenes Präfix .sdf-.

   Schrift: Lato wird vom Kopfzeilen-Block geladen, der auf jeder
   Seite vor der Fusszeile steht. Wird die Fusszeile ohne den
   Kopfzeilen-Block eingesetzt, greift die Systemschrift – dann den
   Font-Block aus assets/fonts/lato.css hier oben einfügen.
   ================================================================ */

/* ---------- 1. Kapselung / Reset -------------------------------- */
.sdxf, .sdxf *, .sdxf *::before, .sdxf *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.sdxf * {
  margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0;
  background: transparent; box-shadow: none;
  font: inherit; line-height: inherit; color: inherit;
  letter-spacing: inherit; word-spacing: inherit; text-align: inherit;
  text-transform: none; text-decoration: none; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none;
  list-style: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: normal;
  float: none; max-width: none; min-width: 0;
}
.sdxf img, .sdxf svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.sdxf a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.sdxf strong, .sdxf b { font-weight: 700; }

/* ---------- 2. Werte -------------------------------------------- */
.sdxf {
  --blue:      #407BA0;
  --blue-soft: #BCD3E5;
  --navy:      #00102E;
  --wrap: 1200px;

  font-family: 'LatoSD', 'Lato', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-variant: normal;
  line-height: 1.65;
  letter-spacing: normal;
  word-spacing: normal;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: none;
  direction: ltr;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

/* ---------- 3. Aufbau ------------------------------------------- */
.sdxf .sdf { background: var(--navy); color: rgba(255,255,255,.62); padding: 72px 0 34px; }
.sdxf .sdf-in { width: 100%; max-width: var(--wrap); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 28px; }
.sdxf .sdf-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 44px; }

.sdxf .sdf-logo img { height: 62px; width: auto; filter: brightness(0) invert(1); opacity: .95; }
.sdxf .sdf-grid p { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 300px; }

.sdxf h4 { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; }
.sdxf ul { margin-top: 18px; display: grid; gap: 11px; }
.sdxf li, .sdxf li a { font-size: 14.5px; }
.sdxf li a { transition: color .2s ease; }
.sdxf li a:hover { color: #FFFFFF; }

.sdxf .sdf-bar {
  margin-top: 56px; padding-top: 26px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 26px; align-items: center;
  font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
}
.sdxf .sdf-bar nav { margin-left: auto; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 22px; }
.sdxf .sdf-bar a { transition: color .2s ease; }
.sdxf .sdf-bar a:hover { color: #FFFFFF; }
.sdxf .sdf-bar .is-on { color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--blue-soft); }

/* ---------- 3b. Fachkreis-Hinweis ------------------------------- */
.sdxf .sdf-fach { background: #071B3D; color: rgba(255,255,255,.70); padding: 20px 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }
.sdxf .sdf-fach__in { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; }
.sdxf .sdf-fach b { flex: none; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue-soft); }

/* ---------- 4. Responsive --------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .sdxf .sdf-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 36px; }
}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .sdxf .sdf-fach__in { flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .sdxf .sdf { padding: 56px 0 30px; }
  .sdxf .sdf-in { padding: 0 20px; }
  .sdxf .sdf-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdxf .sdf-bar { margin-top: 44px; }
  .sdxf .sdf-bar nav { margin-left: 0; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .sdxf * { transition: none !important; }
}
</style>
